scope.interactionChannel: real macOS character and Escape key events after exact-PID activation

observations.name: physical actions-only filter
observations.detail: After the first attempt was rejected as a non-key-window harness mismatch, the exact owned process was activated and a real > character filtered Quick Switch to Actions while hiding Recent Threads.

observations.name: physical actions-only Escape dismissal
observations.detail: A real Escape key dismissed the Actions-only palette and restored the canonical thread view.

observations.name: physical empty filter
observations.detail: After exact-PID activation, real OS typing of zzzz-no-match produced the canonical No matching commands, projects, or threads state.

observations.name: physical empty Escape dismissal
observations.detail: A real Escape key dismissed the empty palette and restored the same canonical thread frame as the Actions-only run.

classification.closedProductLoss: Physical character entry now has retained Native evidence for both Actions-only and empty filter states, and physical Escape dismisses both.
remainingProductLoss: Physical ArrowUp, ArrowDown, and Enter navigation remain unavailable behind the Lynxtron renderer-key event boundary.
missingCoverage: No filtered command activation with Enter is claimed.
Dark-theme Actions-only and empty filters were not repeated and receive no borrowed theme credit.
classification.harnessLoss: The first Actions-only character attempt occurred while the owned window was not key and was excluded. Desktop DevTool registration remains unavailable; retained frames use exact-PID WindowServer capture and immutable snapshot identity.
classification.intentionalPlatformDelta: Escape is captured by a hidden native Menu accelerator and delivered as a normalized packet rather than a renderer DOM key event.
